notes.title: Get Ready for the Adventure with Capybara! We're Looking for Beta Testers
notes.notes:
Attention, gamers! We are thrilled to announce the upcoming release of our new game, Capybara, arriving on all platforms on August 30th. But before its official launch, we need your help to ensure the game is in perfect condition.

We are looking for passionate and curious players to join our beta testing phase. As a beta tester, you’ll have the exclusive opportunity to be one of the first to dive into the world of Capybara, test its features, and help us refine the game before its official release.

How can you become a beta tester? It’s very simple. Just join our Discord community, where we will provide you with a beta key that will allow you to access the game. In addition, on the Discord server, you’ll be able to share your feedback, find tips, and participate in special events alongside other players.

Don’t miss the chance to be part of this incredible adventure. Join our Discord today and secure your spot as a Capybara beta tester. We’re waiting for you!

Official release date: August 30th
Join Discord to get your beta key: [url=https://discord.com/invite/AepbfsE8SV]https://discord.com/invite/AepbfsE8SV[/url]

notes.title: Capybara is Coming! Official Release on August 30, 2024
notes.notes:
Attention all gamers! 🎮

We are thrilled to announce that our new game, Capybara, will be available on [b]August 30, 2024[/b]. Get ready for a clicker adventure like no other!

This week, we've added exciting new features to enhance your gaming experience:

[list]
[*] Steam Leaderboards: Compete with players worldwide and prove who is the best!
[*] Idle System: Now you can earn points automatically when you reopen the game after being away. Don't miss a single moment!
[*] 5 New Items: Explore and discover the new items we've added to help you on your journey to the top.
[/list]
Mark your calendar and join us in this fun and addictive adventure with Capybara. See you on August 30!
